title: ci.yml names the rules check once the App can write workflows
body:
Why: the ship of t-4p169xy exited 83 on a real push of the .github/workflows/ci.yml:67 comment fix: the KRN GitHub App token lacks Workflows (write), so no KRN session can edit workflow files.
Outcome: ci.yml:67 says rendered rules are checked by test/agents-render.test.ts (npm run rules locally), not the retired npm run preflight.
Remedy: the operator grants the KRN GitHub App Workflows (write), or pushes the one-line edit with a login holding the workflow scope; then krn pr ship goes through.
Proof: grep -c 'npm run preflight' .github/workflows/ci.yml prints 0.
